name: github-workflow
description: A disciplined issue-to-PR workflow for coding agents on GitHub: search for duplicates before filing, claim via the comment thread, branch and PR without merging, label to a strict taxonomy, and close with a written record — with opt-in hooks that enforce it.

closing_keyword_gate.title: Accidental closing-keyword gate
closing_keyword_gate.description: Block gh pr create/edit when the PR body contains a closing keyword GitHub would act on by accident (negated, quoted, or inside code). Applies in every repository.

discard_gate.title: Uncommitted-changes discard gate
discard_gate.description: Ask before a git command discards uncommitted changes (git checkout -- <path>, git restore, git reset --hard, git clean -f, git switch --discard-changes, git stash drop/clear, git worktree remove --force) when something would be lost. Applies in every repository.
